857:t_1:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Welcome to the world of '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'.」

857:t_1:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm $$西条涼音$$, your guide for this guidance scenario.」

857:t_1:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm still studying to become a teacher, but I'll do my best to be of as much help to you as I can.」

857:t_1:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He's $$ヒビキ・カミシロ$$, a student in the class I'm teaching for my student teaching placement.」

857:t_1:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He'll be serving as my assistant.」

857:t_1:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes, yes. You're starting to take your role as a guide seriously. At this rate, I think you'll stop being the quiet type soon.」

857:t_1:12.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「When you put it that way, I feel motivated too.」

857:t_1:13.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Then I'll give you all two pieces of advice for playing the game.」

857:t_1:14.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are those two pieces of advice?」

857:t_1:15.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「'Press SELECT when you're in trouble' and 'Check Lecture Plates when you're unsure'... Those are the keys to victory.」

857:t_1:16.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「In many situations, the SELECT button brings up Key Help, which explains the controls.」

857:t_1:17.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「On robot and pilot status screens, it also brings up explanations of abilities and Spirit Commands you don't understand.」

857:t_1:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And what are the 'Lecture Plates' in your other tip?」

857:t_1:19.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「'Lecture Plates' explain this game's systems.」

857:t_1:20.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「On the map, put the cursor on a square with no ally or enemy and press SELECT to open 'Combat Record', which contains...」

857:t_1:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So we can read explanations of the game's systems there.」

857:t_1:23.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「'3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen' is based on the previous game, '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Jigoku-hen', but...」

857:t_1:24.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Various systems have been improved or added. Please check those out in 'Lecture Plates' too.」

857:t_1:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well, you learn by doing, so let's get started with hands-on training on a battle map.」

857:t_2:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You've worked hard, $$ヒビキ$$. Now I'll explain the intermission.」

857:t_2:4.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The intermission is separate from the story. It's where we save game data and prepare for the next scenario, and...」

857:t_2:5.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「...where we set up teams for the Tag Battle System... right?」

857:t_2:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen', intermission 'Lecture Plates' are under 'Support' in 'Team Setup'.」

857:t_2:8.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「So we can find explanations of various systems there, just like on the map.」

857:t_2:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's make good use of those and do our best.」

857:t_2:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「To everyone in front of the screen...」

857:t_2:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This guidance scenario only introduced the basics of the vast world of '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'.」

857:t_2:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「From here on, please see everything this world has to offer with your own eyes.」

857:t_2:14.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And please look forward to seeing $$ヒビキ$$ grow in the main story.」

857:t_2:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I wish you all the best. I'll see you in the main story.」

858:t_000:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now, everyone, control the allied team of $$デルタプラス$$ and $$リゼル$$ and destroy all the enemies.」

858:t_000:1.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「I recommend trying out various commands, such as Spirit Commands and Power Parts.」

858:t_000:2.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「As I said earlier, if you don't understand the game's systems, put the cursor on a square with no ally or enemy...」

858:t_000:3.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「...and press SELECT to open 'Combat Record'. Please read the 'Lecture Plates' there.」

858:t_000:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This scenario has no defeat conditions. Allied units revive if they're shot down, so I recommend treating this as practice and trying all sorts of things.」

858:t_000:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I've given your allied pilots plenty of Spirit Points for this scenario, so please try out various Spirit Commands too.」

858:t_000:6.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Now we'll begin the battle. Please do your best.」

858:t_001:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「I've confirmed that all enemies have been destroyed.」

858:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You even earned an SR Point! You really are impressive.」

858:t_002:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「I've confirmed that all enemies have been destroyed.」

858:t_002:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You've worked hard. I think you've now got a general idea of how to play the game.」

858:t_003:1.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「There was a '???' entry in the Lecture Plates, but...」

858:t_003:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That explains systems added as you progress through the game. See for yourself what systems get added.」

858:t_003:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone... Real battles are more complex than this guidance scenario, and the enemies are tougher, but there's no need to worry.」

858:t_003:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you advance while checking what you can do, one step at a time, you're sure to clear the game.」

858:t_003:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That concludes the battle map guidance. Next, we'll explain the intermission.」

858:t_004:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「$$デルタプラス$$ has been shot down!」

858:t_004:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Since this is a guidance scenario, I'll make an exception and revive it.」

858:t_005:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「$$リゼル$$ has been shot down!」

858:t_005:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Since this is a guidance scenario, I'll make an exception and revive it.」

858:t_006:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The team has been wiped out!」

858:t_006:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Since this is a guidance scenario, I'll make an exception and revive it.」

858:t_007:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The point of this guidance scenario is to get a feel for Super Robot Wars, so don't be afraid to try things.」

858:t_007:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even if your units are shot down, I'll make an exception and revive them.」

858:t_007:2.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Please do your best without being afraid to fail.」
